Title: Re: blood brother dual form / embrace

Messages.Author: gotcha
Messages.Body:
I guess not but just to make sure I cannot make the fun deck:
An embrace made by or a dual form played by a blood brother is a blood brother but not part of their circle, right?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Please include the relevant card texts: we are glad to answer, but you must make the mininum effort (it's not the first time).

Name: Dual Form
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Protean
+1 stealth action.
[pro] Untap this vampire. During this minion phase, you may untap this vampire again.
[PRO] This acting vampire's capacity is reduced by 1. Put this card in play, tapped. It becomes a non-unique vampire with the same clan, capacity and Disciplines as the acting vampire. You may move up to 2 blood from the acting vampire to this vampire. If either minion leaves the ready region, the other is burned.

Name: The Embrace
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready non-Sterile vampire.
Put this card in play; it becomes a non-unique vampire with 1 capacity of the same clan as the acting vampire. This vampire must hunt this turn.

First of all, all Blood Brothers are sterile so they can't play those cards. Even if they could play the card, the Dual Form doesn't copy anything else than the "clan, capacity and Disciplines" so it doesn't copy the circle. Embrace creates a vampire "of the same clan" and doesn't copy the circle.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
